Name: RIDE_PARAM_ST
Description: Mounting rules for a rider and mount pair: Torrent, and enemies that ride horses or operate siege weapons. When a character tries to mount, the game checks every row whose Rider and Mount Model IDs match the two characters; a row is usable when the distance, height and both angle checks pass. Several rows per pair give different ride-on animations for different approach sides.

Fields.Name: Rider Model ID
Fields.Description: Model number of the rider (cXXXX, e.g. 3000 for c3000; 0 is the player). Must match the rider's model for this row to be used.

Fields.Name: Mount Model ID
Fields.Description: Model number of the mount (cXXXX, e.g. 8000 for Torrent). Must match the mount's model for this row to be used.

Fields.Name: Ride - Camera Param ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail sets 3010 (a LockCamParam row) on the Torrent rows; the riding camera uses its own fixed rows.

Fields.Name: Rider - Ride-On Animation Variant
Fields.Description: Value given to the rider's ride-on animation when mounting with this row; selects which mount animation plays. Retail: 1 from behind, 2 from the left, 3 from the right on horses; 1, 11 and 21 on the ballista, trebuchet and flamethrower.

Fields.Name: Mount - Ridden Animation Variant
Fields.Description: Value given to the mount's ridden animation when mounted with this row. Retail always equals Rider - Ride-On Animation Variant.

Fields.Name: Mount - Adjust Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly on the mount that the rider is attached to (the rider side always uses its dummy poly 500). Retail: 900 Torrent, 511–513 for the different approach sides.

Fields.Name: Mount - Check Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly on the mount that the distance and angle checks are measured to. -1 or a missing dummy poly: the mount's own position. Retail -1 on every row.

Fields.Name: Rider Facing Angle Limit
Fields.Description: Maximum angle (degrees) between the rider's facing and the direction to the mount. 180: any facing.

Fields.Name: Mount Distance
Fields.Description: The rider must be closer than this distance (m, straight-line) to the mount.

Fields.Name: Mount Distance - Max Height Above
Fields.Description: How far (m) the mount may be above the rider.

Fields.Name: Mount Distance - Max Height Below
Fields.Description: How far (m) the mount may be below the rider.

Fields.Name: Approach Angle - Min
Fields.Description: Start of the allowed approach window: the rider's position around the mount, in degrees from the mount's front (0 front, ±180 behind; one side negative, the other positive). If Min is greater than Max, the window wraps through 180 (e.g. 150 to -150 is behind the mount). -180 to 180: any side.

Fields.Name: Approach Angle - Max
Fields.Description: End of the allowed approach window, in degrees from the mount's front (see Approach Angle - Min).
